verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a Cloud REST API reference (pulumi-docs-50), and its `pulumi api` CLI command can call any Pulumi Cloud REST API endpoint (pulumi-docs-49, pulumi-docs-44). That gives a reference plus a first-party way to execute calls, but there is no evidence the reference is interactive or has in-page runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec (pulumi-probe-3). missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer or try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
